title: The Rental Market Signal
scenario: A city caps rent below the previous market-clearing level. Mission Control must explain the queues for available flats.

evidence_cards.title: Market survey
evidence_cards.detail: At the capped rent, 8,000 households seek flats while owners offer 5,000.

evidence_cards.title: Landlord response
evidence_cards.detail: Some owners convert long-term rentals to other uses after the cap.

evidence_cards.title: Weather report
evidence_cards.detail: Rainfall was typical for the season.

evidence_cards.title: Campaign logo
evidence_cards.detail: The policy campaign used a blue logo.

allowed_actions.label: Identify a shortage and monitor supply incentives
Declare that lower prices created abundance

success_conditions: Compare quantity demanded with quantity supplied

curveball.scenario: The city adds a construction subsidy. New rental supply may enter, so the shortage must be reassessed rather than assumed unchanged.
curveball.expected_reasoning: The subsidy changes producer incentives and potentially quantity supplied; collect new quantity data.

expected_reasoning: Because quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied at the capped price, the market has a shortage.
answer_explanation: The quantity evidence establishes a shortage, while owner withdrawals show a supply response.
